home.text: Hello, My name is Yakubenka Ivan. And this is myself presentation project. I have education as engineer of radio electronic. I started learning programming in college from assembler and C. From 2012 to 2024 year I worked as an engineer, my jod was maintenancing finance department . Part of my job was a maintenancing programs and which used SQL so I lerned SQL in start of my carrier./n Then I interested web technology and started study php which was popular. For php I needed to known html and I had learned it and created first pages. But it looked so bad and I had to learn css and js too. Having this knowledge, I thought I am well and send resume for a job as js developer. Tested task was easy but interview was on English and that was not easy, I failed. But I made conclusions and started study English harder. I had heard about java course in EPAM and send resume to it. I passed on second time. I done well first part courses which was online and wait invite to offline part, I needed relocate for it, but  invite delayed and I made decision stay in my position. /nAfter 2 years my company was finding front-end developer and I was hired. That project used .Net Framework and I success took 2 courses .net. But after 2 months team has been made decision migrate project from web to desktop app.  I thought I needed up my skils and started develop one of my project from courses. That project registredmy contracts, payrolls and bonuses. After fired out I made some rest and then make decision that I want write full site. I started rewrite random site by react and after some time I get proposition from friend to make site for her.  I wrote it by figma layout and deployed on hosting. Gusmaryhair site was online half year and owner decided not prolongation hosting. Now I have some contracts for maitanance and for automatization calculation and registration I write one more service.

srvScan.desc1: At some point, the head of the department decided that daily, several times a day, it was necessary to check the operation of programs on the server and the contents of work folders. After several days of manual execution, I have desire and ideas how to automate these processes. It was forbidden to install third-party software on the servers, so solutions written in Java or C# were not suitable. Everything had to be done using standard Windows tools. This is how the SrvScan module was written.
srvScan.desc2: Initially, an HTML file was supposed to be generated that opened and I could track the execution. After demonstrating to the head of the department, he suggested rewriting it to generate XML and send it to his server, where he collected information from all servers and sent messages if there were problems.

getInfo.desc1: According to the work regulations, users workstations had to be checked once a month. To check, you had to physically be at the employee's workstation and check the status of the PC and OS. The GetInfo module was written to automate this process. It was forbidden to install third-party software on the PC, so solutions written in Java or C# were not suitable. Everything had to be done using standard Windows tools.
getInfo.desc2: GetInfo was installed in the scheduled tasks and executed once a week. Thanks to this, I could monitor the status of the PC remotely, without disturbing users, and I get all the necessary information in one place.

gusMary.desc: This project was done as 'turnkey'. By the beginning of development, I had written several pet projects that worked locally and wanted to write a full-fledged site for hosting. A friend offer me to write a site and I got down to work with pleasure. /n The designer made a layout in Figma. Initially, the Faunadb service was used to store data, and hosting was planned on Netlify. However, when everything was in the final stage, it turned out that according to the law, sites selling or advertising goods and services must be hosted on hostings within the country. /n So the database was rewritten for MySQL and the site was hosted using CPanel.

contracts.desc: Now I have several contracts for servicing programs and peripheral equipment of organizations. To account for the services provided and to keep records of settlement transactions, the Contracts project was written.

payroll.desc: At the end of the Advanced C# course, I had to write an exam project. I wrote a project of accounting for organizations that have signed a contract with IVCMinfina for the maintenance of software and PCs and servers. The project included a list of organizations, contracts and contact persons. /n During the first years of my work at IVCMinfin, the payroll were sent by mail and there were only a few lines, everything was readable and understandable. But over time, they became more and more complicated and began to be sent in the form of an Excel document. /n In order to simplify the control of payments according to the contracts, as well as the general reading and understanding of payments and deductions, the project has added the ability to download payroll and view payments in a convenient way. Later, authentication was added for restrict access to information of payments.
